name: Race Condition Vulnerabilities
source: Race Condition Vulnerabilities/Race Condition Vulnerabilities - Interview Questions & Answers.md

prompts.title: Q: Lost update vs write skew?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** **Lost update:** two transactions both read X, both write based on stale X; last write wins-**first** change lost. **Write skew:** two transactions read **different** rows; each update is "locally" valid but **together** they violate a **global** rule (classic under **snapshot isolation**).

prompts.title: Q: Why are races a “business logic” issue?
prompts.answerMarkdown:
**A:** The code is often "correct" for **one** request at a time but wrong under **parallel** use-scanners miss it; **threat modeling** and **code review** catch it.

---

prompts.title: Q: Best fix for a wallet debit?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** Prefer **`UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance - $amt WHERE id = $id AND balance >= $amt`** and verify **one row** updated; add **idempotency** for the **operation** key to handle **retries**.

prompts.title: Q: When do you need SERIALIZABLE?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** When **multiple rows** or **invariants** span reads/writes that **snapshot** isolation allows to skew. Expect **retries** on serialization failures-pair with **idempotency**.

prompts.title: Q: Distributed system without shared DB row?
prompts.answerMarkdown:
**A:** **Per-aggregate** **single writer** (queue), **distributed lock** with **lease** (careful with TTL/fencing), or **consensus**-never a **process-local** mutex alone.

---

prompts.title: Q: How do you prove a race in a bug bounty safely?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** **Coordinated** disclosure scope; **non-destructive** parallel requests; **document** timestamps and **duplicate** resource IDs; stop if **availability** impact.

prompts.title: Q: How do you regression-test races?
prompts.answerMarkdown:
**A:** **Load** test with **controlled** parallelism; **property** tests; **assert** DB constraints (`balance >= 0`); monitor **serialization** errors after hardening.

---

prompts.title: Q: Optimistic locking downside?
prompts.answerMarkdown:
**A:** **Retries** and **UX** under **contention**; clients must handle **409 Conflict** and **backoff**.

---
